# Docs

- Blog
  - [Introducing Fumapress](https://press.fumadocs.dev/blog/introducing-fumapress): Build content sites with React.js.
- Documentation
  - [Introduction](https://press.fumadocs.dev/docs): Turn your content into a website.
  - [Configurations](https://press.fumadocs.dev/docs/config): Available options.
  - [Internationalization](https://press.fumadocs.dev/docs/internationalization): Internationalize your Fumapress app.
  - Adapters
    - [Adapters](https://press.fumadocs.dev/docs/adapters): Connect content sources to Fumapress.
    - [Fumadocs MDX](https://press.fumadocs.dev/docs/adapters/mdx): Adapter for Fumadocs MDX.
  - Guides
    - [Guides](https://press.fumadocs.dev/docs/guides): Beginner-level guides for basic setups.
    - [Using Base UI](https://press.fumadocs.dev/docs/guides/base-ui): Use the Base UI component library instead of Radix UI.
    - [Fonts](https://press.fumadocs.dev/docs/guides/font): How to add fonts.
    - [Routing](https://press.fumadocs.dev/docs/guides/routing): Different ways to create a new page.
  - Layouts
    - [Layouts](https://press.fumadocs.dev/docs/layouts): Use and customize layouts in Fumapress.
    - [Docs Layout](https://press.fumadocs.dev/docs/layouts/docs): Render documentation pages with sidebar navigation and table of contents.
    - [Home Layout](https://press.fumadocs.dev/docs/layouts/home): Render standalone pages with the shared home layout.
    - [Notebook Layout](https://press.fumadocs.dev/docs/layouts/notebook): Render reference pages with the notebook appearance.
  - Plugins
    - [Plugins](https://press.fumadocs.dev/docs/plugins): Extend Fumapress via plugins.
    - [AI](https://press.fumadocs.dev/docs/plugins/ai): Add "Ask AI" to your Fumapress app.
    - [AsyncAPI](https://press.fumadocs.dev/docs/plugins/asyncapi): Build event-driven API documentations with Fumapress.
    - [Blog](https://press.fumadocs.dev/docs/plugins/blog): Build a blog system with Fumapress.
    - [Feedback](https://press.fumadocs.dev/docs/plugins/feedback): Collect feedback from your Fumapress app.
    - [FlexSearch](https://press.fumadocs.dev/docs/plugins/flexsearch): Add built-in full-text search with FlexSearch.
    - [Image Optimization](https://press.fumadocs.dev/docs/plugins/image): Optimize images under different viewports.
    - [Link Validation](https://press.fumadocs.dev/docs/plugins/link-validation): Detect broken links during build.
    - [llms.txt](https://press.fumadocs.dev/docs/plugins/llms.txt): Expose your documentation as LLM-friendly text files.
    - [MCP](https://press.fumadocs.dev/docs/plugins/mcp): Expose your documentation to MCP clients.
    - [OpenAPI](https://press.fumadocs.dev/docs/plugins/openapi): Build API documentations with Fumapress.
    - [Orama Search](https://press.fumadocs.dev/docs/plugins/orama-search): Add built-in full-text search with Orama.
    - [Sitemap](https://press.fumadocs.dev/docs/plugins/sitemap): Generate a sitemap.xml for your Fumapress site.
    - [Takumi](https://press.fumadocs.dev/docs/plugins/takumi): Generate Open Graph images for your documentation pages.
